profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Astec Industries | Angular, TypeScript, C#, .NET |
profile.summary: I am a motivated individual with experience in producing effective websites and an appreciation for working with others in the workplace.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
•	Lead new product development for our iWave embedded telematics option.
•	Create 100’s of Angular versions 2 - 21 of Components from expectations given by a designer.
•	Pervasive use of NGRX stores to manage state across Angular components.
•	Implement countless C# .NET backend endpoints handling Telemetry data with Microsoft SQL Server and Entity Framework based on discussions with fellow Sr. Software Engineers to meet the expectations from my program managers and designers.
•	Created Vue components and feature for the Orion-Peterson and e-ticketing apps
•	Confirm installation of Orion devices on CAT and Roadtec machines
•	Cleaned up code rot of the e-ticketing Vue front end and flask back-end code base.
•	Create and maintain flask backend.
•	Optimized query statements and pagination with SQLAlchemy
•	Maintain and host applications with Azure.
•	Squashed bugs and in Code reviews
•	Maintained preexisting build pipeline automation using git hooks.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Created Video Management Systems.
* Angular Front End Development
* Node + Express Back End Development
* MySql Database
* Windows Server 2019 Single Sign On configuration
* Created Network Access Storage Device from scratch using Samba and Angular with a node back end.
* Linux Server Configuration
* Created a mechanism for exporting videos with FFMPEG
* Implemented Build pipeline that transform raw code into an intuitive msi installer using wix toolkit, jenkins and bitbucket.

positions.title: Build Engineer
positions.description:
* Rebuilt halo build system for 343 industries
* Implemented a Jenkins pipeline that can take 7 different configurations.
* Used perforce as the version control software.
Created custom build scripts.
Deployed build artifacts to a shared hard drive.
Fixed bugs that prevented legacy code from building with newer dependencies.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed key features for C-Scape, a ground control station that directed drones for the navy.
•	Implemented the CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins and Bitbucket on a Linux Server located on AWS.
•	Worked with a team that used AGILE/SCRUM methodologies using JIRA.
•	Implemented features of C-Scape using python, typescript, angular, electron, mongoDB, and nodeJS
•	Designed key feature of Contract Management Software (CMS) that allowed program managers to spend less time asking engineers within the company what their skills are and more time perfecting their decisions.
•	Implemented the CI/CD pipeline for CMS in Jenkins and Gitlab.
•	Wrote documentation on the build and usage process for CMS as well as DevOps tutorials used internally at SOLUTE
•	Was in charge of making sure all the code that was streaming in from other members of the team formed a coherent build.
•	Ensured there was always a working build.
•	Designed the database schema for CMS
•	Performed changes to the PostgreSQL database, Java / Springboot backend, and Angular front-end to ensure compatibility with each other and all features worked properly.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Creating and designing macOS applications in swift.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
* Enabled the creation of cut scenes, specifically the timeline through contribution to game development tools that interfaced with Unity. 
* Created a way to visualize gathered gameplay data by designing and building a Dev Tool in C# and WPF using a MVVM architecture.
* Debugged software as bugs were found.
* Reduced design time for artists through my contributions to Unreal Engine tools
* Mortal Combat 11
* WxWidgets

positions.title: Security Guard
positions.description:
* Provided customer service to clients.
* Dealt with difficult situations.
* Monitored security cameras
